name: Real Analysis I: Deltavane
subtitle: Real Analysis: epsilon-delta
shortDescription: Adaptive real analysis course: epsilon-delta proofs, sequences, series and continuity, checked exactly. Free to use.
longDescription:
Deltavane is an adaptive undergraduate Real Analysis course you can carry in your pocket: a first course in real analysis covering epsilon-delta proofs, sequences, series, continuity, compactness and the Riemann integral. Instead of only reading proofs, you build them: choose the delta for an epsilon-delta limit and the app checks it exactly, choose N for a sequence and watch the tail stay inside the epsilon tube, put proof steps in a valid order, spot the flawed line, and break false claims with counterexamples.

### What you study
The real numbers and the completeness axiom; sequences and limits; monotone convergence; Bolzano-Weierstrass; Cauchy sequences; series and convergence tests; limits of functions and continuity; uniform continuity; open, closed, compact and connected sets; differentiation and the mean value theorem; the Riemann integral and the fundamental theorem of calculus; pointwise and uniform convergence of function sequences.

### How it adapts
Two learning paths: Personalised (the app chooses the next problem from your mastery, your repeated slips and spaced reviews) or Traditional (curriculum order). Switch any time.

### Interactive labs
An epsilon-delta game, an epsilon-N tube, Riemann sums, pointwise versus uniform convergence, and a Cantor set explorer. Every worked solution is free. Step-down pop-ups explain a concept at school or calculus level when you are stuck, and step-up notes point to what comes next. References to university courses, textbooks and videos open in an in-app window with the source, licence and a link.

Before this course: Calculus I and II, Discrete Mathematics (proof writing). After: Real Analysis II, Complex Analysis, Topology, Measure Theory.

Free with ads at natural breaks (never during a timed mock exam or before a solution), with an optional monthly ad-free plan. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any university, publisher or course named in the app.
